title: Panda waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->

  <ellipse cx='31' cy='68' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#5868a0' transform='rotate(25 31 68)'/>

  <circle cx='74' cy='49' r='6' fill='#7a8ac0'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#a3b1de'/>
  <circle cx='77' cy='46' r='2.2' fill='#a3b1de'/>
  <circle cx='74.5' cy='50' r='2.2' fill='#a3b1de'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#5868a0'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5.5' fill='#5868a0'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='24' fill='#e8eef5'/>

  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='3.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='3.4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#2b3560'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#2b3560'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#7a8ac0'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 49 Q45 54 40 51' fill='none' stroke='#7a8ac0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 Q55 54 60 51' fill='none' stroke='#7a8ac0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#f0a0b8' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='46' r='3.5' fill='#f0a0b8' opacity='0.8'/>
